name: Legoo-Win
author: iamracer
description:
About:
This is my entry submission for the Unity x Lego Microgame. Play and tell me what you think about my mod, cheers!

Description:
Your mission is to reach a final checkpoint, along the line you have obstacles to avoid in other to complete the mission.

Controls:
[Space] to jump.
[WASD/Arrow] for movement.
[ESC] to pause game.
